simple.meaning: to balance , i.e. measure out (by weight or dimension); figuratively to arrange , equalize , through the idea of levelling (ment, estimate , test )
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תָּכַן (H8505) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
